prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game cosmetic VFX overlay for the Mythic rarity in the existing FPTU Xperience reward arcade.
Primary request: an exquisite prismatic kaleidoscope halo that makes the rarest club reward feel genuinely extraordinary.
Subject: ONE circular jewel halo, an eightfold radial mandala made of finely cut translucent crystal petals, smaller diamond facets, thin champagne-gold filigree and sparse tiny four-point star glints. Iridescent opal reflections, ice cyan, rose and violet highlights; pale gold structural edges.
Style/medium: premium physically rendered collectible game cosmetic, crisp bevels and beautiful studio rim light, refined rather than bulky. No cartoon outlines.
Composition: square, perfectly centered, straight-on symmetrical frontal view. The entire halo fits within 88% of the canvas, with generous transparent outer margins. Its central circular hole occupies 54% of the canvas diameter and is FULLY TRANSPARENT, for a separate club emblem to be composited by the web app. The ring occupies only the annulus around that hole. Small transparent gaps between crystal petals preserve the kaleidoscope silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha, including the entire central hole. This is an isolated overlay, not a card, screenshot, or scene.
Lighting/mood: restrained magical sparkle with precise highlights readable on a midnight-navy UI, subtle softly translucent reflections close to the ring.
Constraints: no emblem inside the hole, no club logo, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no frame around the canvas. No black disc or filled background. Do not fill the transparent hole with a pattern. Avoid heavy haze, exploding particles, oversized lens flares and clipped edges.
